recipe.name: Ale Punch
directions:
Combine all ingredients in a punch bowl and slip in a large block of ice. Grate nutmeg over the surface of the punch and ladle into punch glasses. Serves 6-8.
CapillaireCombine 2 cups of sugar and 1 cup of water in a pot over medium heat and stir until dissolved. Remove from heat, stir in 1/2 tsp. of orange flower water and bottle. Store refrigerated. Makes about 2 cups (480mL).
